title: RuntimeConfig
description: v0.2. Per-environment config the Angular app fetches from /config.json before bootstrap (provideAppInitializer). Lets one build run in any environment (native, docker compose, Codespaces, CI) without a rebuild. Contains no secrets. See SPEC FR10, FR11 and DECISIONS #8.

environment.description: Shown in the shell header so a demo always states where it is running.

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Go API, e.g. http://localhost:8080. Its origin is cross-origin to the web app, so the API's CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS must list the web app's origin (SPEC §6.3).

provider.description: fdc3 = getAgent() against a Desktop Agent (falls back to in-memory on timeout); in-memory = BroadcastChannel only. CI and E2E use in-memory.

connectTimeoutMs.description: getAgent() timeout. The shipped configs use 3000.

theme.description: Initial theme (FR11). A user's toggle choice, when remembered, wins.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often quote views re-fetch GET /quotes (FR1). 0 disables polling; E2E and visual tests use 0.

auth.description: Reserved seam for an OAuth2/OIDC provider. Auth is a non-goal (SPEC §3): `enabled` must be false in this POC and no login is implemented. The shape mirrors common OIDC SPA settings so a real provider could be wired in behind an AUTH token without changing callers.

clientId.description: Public client ID (not a secret). Empty in this POC.

authority.description: Issuer/authority URL. Empty in this POC.
